title: How to Attract Chinese Tourists Through Little Red Book? - Charlesworth Group - ENAGO Company

facts.fact: Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) is reported by the vendor to have over 300 million registered users.
facts.quote: Xiaohongshu is a social commerce platform with over 300 million registered users and approximately 350 million monthly active users.

facts.fact: The vendor states that traditionally about 70% of Xiaohongshu users are female.
facts.quote: While traditionally about 70% of users are female, male engagement is gradually increasing as content diversifies.

facts.fact: The vendor states that over 85% of Xiaohongshu users are based in urban centres in China.
facts.quote: with over 85% based in urban centres.

facts.fact: The vendor cites unnamed research stating that 85% of Chinese tourists consult social platforms before booking travel.
facts.quote: 85% of Chinese tourists consult social platforms before booking travel

facts.fact: The vendor states that posts with 3-5 relevant hashtags typically perform better than posts with too many or too few tags, based on unnamed research.
facts.quote: Research shows that posts with 3-5 relevant hashtags typically perform better than those with too many or too few tags.

facts.fact: The article was published on 28 October 2025.
